title: Made a full scratch-off gambling game with Claude, heading to Steam
author: Responsible_Web934
selftext:
First game I’ve finished. One More Ticket is a single HTML file: all the art is drawn in code and the music and sound are generated live. No asset files at all.

You start with a trash bag and $5,000 of debt to a guy named Vinnie. Dig cans behind the gas station, buy scratch-off tickets, actually scratch them, and try to pay off a chain of bosses who keep getting worse.

There’s also a truck stop with snake tickets, plus Vegas with slots, blackjack (the dealer drinks) and a Wheel of (miss)Fortune.

About an hour to beat. Plays in the browser, best on PC.

I’m not a programmer. I designed it, play tested it with friends and bots, and iterated a lot. Happy to answer questions about the process.

🎮 Play: [One More Ticket by Willdabosses](https://willdabosses.itch.io/one-more-ticket)  
🎬 Trailer and a quick feedback form are in the comments.
